summary: Add bounded read-only Matrix polling of the existing hbnf-cart-control live_status projection and schedule score overlays through the current renderer.

scoped_evidence.approved_architecture_reference: Current owner instruction authorizes a minimal firmware-side read-only polling integration; implementation stays in the existing WLED usermod, existing ESP-IDF HTTP client and FreeRTOS, existing live_status selector and existing Matrix overlay renderer.
scoped_evidence.rollback_reference: Installed Vibe-first firmware hbnf-cart2-phase2-r6-vibe-first-ui-20261012, SHA-256 43a33dfa21127a79f643ede9b2a054ff1aa21705b7733cfebea9c8a3e105c5f3; no live installation is authorized.
evidence_sources: WLED 16.0.1 installed source d01a2f6f5ae02deb0901dc48490de0cd777ee9fa and its existing hbnf-live-v1 receiver, renderer, manual-overlay precedence, and local UI.
staging/coordinated-backend/hbnf-cart-control/index.ts live_status action performs a league_state SELECT and calls chooseLive; it does not write scoring data.
ESP-IDF 4.4.8 esp_http_client and esp_crt_bundle documentation; HTTPS certificate bundle verification and bounded client timeout are used.
Read-only call to deployed hbnf-cart-control live_status returned HTTP 200 and a compact 75-byte inactive-state response; credentials and score contents were not logged.
Read-only Matrix identity confirms the installed Vibe-first release and expected Matrix identity; no device state was changed.
